data.body: Reproduced on a store copy after humdrum-priestly-lcont merged: 3 ids = 3 whole-store passes, 29,238 reductions, peak 44.8 MB (1 id = 1 pass, 9,746). Plan revised: the repeat is build_dep_graph's per-id cache miss reloading the whole store; per-id fields already come from a single-directory reduce in show_state, so original plan item 2 needs no change. The fix shares one memoised states loader across the ids.
